schema.text: When you use public transport, what do you do when streets, stops or paths are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?

options.text: I notice it, but carry on as usual
It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
I avoid some stops or stretches
I stop using that route altogether

schema.help: Think about waiting at stops and travelling on board public transport.

en.#When you use public transport, what do: When you use public transport, what do you do when streets, stops or paths are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?
en.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: I notice it, but carry on as usual
en.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
en.#I avoid some stops or stretches: I avoid some stops or stretches
en.#I stop using that route altogether: I stop using that route altogether
en.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Think about waiting at stops and travelling on board public transport.

it.#When you use public transport, what do: Quando usi i mezzi pubblici, cosa fai quando strade, fermate o percorsi sono sporchi o mal tenuti (rifiuti, cattivi odori, vetri rotti)?
it.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Me ne accorgo, ma vado avanti come sempre
it.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: È spiacevole, ma passo lo stesso da lì
it.#I avoid some stops or stretches: Evito alcune fermate o alcuni tratti
it.#I stop using that route altogether: Smetto del tutto di usare quel percorso
it.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Pensa all’attesa alla fermata e al viaggio a bordo dei mezzi pubblici.

fr.#When you use public transport, what do: Lorsque vous utilisez les transports en commun, que faites-vous quand les rues, les arrêts ou les chemins sont sales ou mal entretenus (déchets, odeurs, verre brisé) ?
fr.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Je le remarque, mais je continue comme d'habitude
fr.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: C'est désagréable, mais je passe quand même par là
fr.#I avoid some stops or stretches: J'évite certains arrêts ou certains tronçons
fr.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Pensez à l’attente aux arrêts et au trajet à bord des transports en commun.

de.#When you use public transport, what do: Was tun Sie bei Fahrten mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, wenn Straßen, Haltestellen oder Wege schmutzig oder schlecht gepflegt sind (Müll, Gerüche, Glasscherben)?
de.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Ich merke es, mache aber wie gewohnt weiter
de.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: Es ist unangenehm, aber ich gehe trotzdem diesen Weg
de.#I avoid some stops or stretches: Ich meide manche Haltestellen oder Abschnitte
de.#I stop using that route altogether: Ich nutze diese Strecke gar nicht mehr
de.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Denken Sie an das Warten an Haltestellen und die Fahrt in öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln.

tr.#When you use public transport, what do: Toplu taşıma kullanırken sokaklar, duraklar veya yollar kirli ya da bakımsız olduğunda (çöp, kokular, kırık cam) ne yaparsınız?
tr.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Fark ederim ama her zamanki gibi devam ederim
tr.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: Hoş değil ama yine de oradan giderim
tr.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Duraklarda beklemeyi ve toplu taşıma araçlarında yolculuk yapmayı düşünün.

fa.#When you use public transport, what do: هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی، وقتی خیابان‌ها، ایستگاه‌ها یا مسیرها کثیف یا نگهداری‌نشده‌اند (زباله، بوی بد، شیشه شکسته) چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: متوجه می‌شوم، اما مثل همیشه ادامه می‌دهم
fa.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: ناخوشایند است، اما باز هم از آنجا می‌روم
fa.#I avoid some stops or stretches: از بعضی ایستگاه‌ها یا بخش‌هایی از مسیر دوری می‌کنم
fa.#I stop using that route altogether: دیگر اصلاً از آن مسیر استفاده نمی‌کنم
fa.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: انتظار در ایستگاه‌ها و سفر با وسایل حمل‌ونقل عمومی را در نظر بگیرید.

hu.#When you use public transport, what do: Tömegközlekedés közben mit tesz, ha az utcák, megállók vagy utak koszosak vagy elhanyagoltak (szemét, szagok, törött üveg)?
hu.#I stop using that route altogether: Egyáltalán nem használom többé azt az útvonalat
hu.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Gondoljon a megállókban való várakozásra és a tömegközlekedési járműveken való utazásra.

ar.#When you use public transport, what do: عند استخدام وسائل النقل العام، ما تصرّفك عندما تكون الشوارع أو المحطات أو الممرات متسخة أو سيئة الصيانة (قمامة أو روائح أو زجاج مكسور)؟
ar.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: الأمر غير مريح، لكنني أمرّ من هناك مع ذلك
ar.#I stop using that route altogether: أتوقف تمامًا عن استخدام ذلك الطريق
ar.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: فكّر في الانتظار في المحطات والسفر على متن وسائل النقل العام.
